reply.text:
I can look at what you logged over the weekend so I'm working from real numbers, not guesses. Nothing is logged in your food log for the last few days, so I can't see what the weekend looked like in numbers. I also don't have a program on record for you right now, so there's nothing to adjust there yet.

Here's what I'd do: a single off weekend doesn't undo your progress, so don't try to make up for it by cutting or training harder this week. Get back to your usual eating and your normal sessions. If you want me to check how the training side has been going, tell me which lifts you care about and I'll pull the numbers. And if you start logging meals, I can tell you what the days actually show.
